title: Convor — Ecwid app registration manifest
description: Reference of the values to register in the Ecwid developer portal (https://developers.ecwid.com/register). Ecwid does not consume this file at install time; it documents the app config so the storefront customizer, OAuth redirect, and scopes are reproducible.

appId.description: Issued by Ecwid on registration. Also the public-storage appId used by Ecwid.getAppPublicConfig(appId) in storefront.js.

appType.description: External (server-side) app: handles OAuth itself, stores tokens server-side.

scopes.description: Access scopes requested from the merchant.

redirectUri.description: Must match ECWID_REDIRECT_URL. The OAuth return URL where the temporary code is delivered.

storefrontCustomization.description: Registered with Ecwid support: a single HTTPS .js URL auto-loaded on every storefront page when the app is installed. The script reads per-store config and injects the Convor widget.

iframeSettingsUrl.description: The /app page rendered inside the Ecwid Control Panel iframe.
